reason: The text (Genesis 12:1-9) depicts Yahweh establishing a covenant with Abram, promising to make him a great nation, to bless him, and to bless all families of the earth through him. There is no statement or implication that Yahweh doesn't owe loyalty to the people or that he considers replacing them with another people. The passage shows the opposite—Yahweh actively initiating a relationship of blessing and covenant loyalty.
